Aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 7 or Core i5/i7 chip. That covers most programming well within ₹80,000.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum. Take 32 GB if you run Docker or phone emulators.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more.
Screen and keyboard: 14 to 15.6 inch full HD, with a keyboard you like typing on.
Battery: look for real-world reviews showing 8 hours or more.
Graphics: skip a dedicated card unless you also game or train AI projects.

Which do you prefer: Windows, Mac or Linux? I can then look up current options in your budget.
